== Summary ==
[[Matt Scott]] (left, black-and-white track jacket) in a match. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

'''Identification:''' Matt Scott is the player in the black-and-white track jacket in [[:File:2021 World Championship Final Confrontation.jpg]] (captioned "Matt Scott and Joe Olson") and in [[:File:2021 World Championship Top 8.jpg]] ("Scott", top right).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Camera timestamp:''' 2021:10:09 17:57:01 (EXIF; camera clock not verified)
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-20
* '''Image:''' native forum attachment, 4592×2584 (full size; replaced an earlier 2400 px copy on 22 November 2026).
